name: Broker hold on early-claim + threshold pattern
condition: Broker with ≥ 15 claims where early-claim (≤ 45 days) share or near-threshold ($8–10k) share is improbable versus the book (binomial tail < 1e-6)

actions.do: Suspend new binding and renewals for the broker
Open SIU file on policies and claims
Route every claim from this broker to senior review regardless of amount

ifWrong: A hold is a review, not a termination; if SIU clears the broker, payments are released and the broker reinstated. False alarms cost a few weeks of binding.

name: Near-threshold claim audit
condition: Any claim between 80% and 100% of the $10,000 senior-review line, or any group whose share in that band exceeds 3× the book

actions.do: Send all flagged-broker near-threshold claims to senior review
Sample 25% of other near-threshold claims for audit

ifWrong: Wasted review time on honest claims; mitigated by sampling only 25% outside flagged sources.

name: Ageing-claim escalation and retention call
condition: Open or under-review claim older than 14 days (the 20-day line minus a 6-day buffer)

actions.do: Move to the priority queue and ask the adjuster for a status update
Escalate claims ≥ $10,000 to the fast-track reviewer

ifWrong: An unnecessary call to a customer whose claim was already moving; low cost.

name: Pricing review ticket
condition: City × product with ≥ 150 policies, combined ratio (loss ratio × (1 + LAE) + expenses) above 1.05, and claim-frequency ratio with 95% CI lower bound above 1.3

actions.do: Open pricing review with the indicated change table
Freeze broker new business in the segment until rated

ifWrong: A review ticket costs analyst time only; no price changes without an actuarial filing.

name: Ingestion validation
condition: Premium stored as text, non-ISO dates, duplicate claim IDs or city-label variants in a new extract

actions.do: Repair rows and log each change

ifWrong: A wrongly repaired row is logged and reversible; original files are never edited.
